title: The 3-Test Check: God’s Voice or My Thoughts?
hook: God or just your thoughts? Run this 3‑test check in 30 seconds.
script: Test 1: Scripture. Does it match the Bible? God won’t contradict His Word. See John 10:27 and 2 Timothy 3:16. Test 2: Fruit and peace. Is it pure, gentle, willing to yield? Do you sense love, joy, and self‑control, not panic? James 3:17 and Galatians 5:22. Test 3: Counsel and providence. Do wise believers affirm it, and are doors reasonably opening? Proverbs 11:14. If two tests fail, pause. If all three align, obey with courage. Breathe and pray, “Lord, align me with Your Word.” Save this for the next swirl of thoughts.

title: 30-Second Clarity When God Feels Silent
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, try this 30‑second clarity check. Example: Should I take that offer? Ask, Does this align with Scripture, or does it ask me to compromise? God’s voice will never require disobedience. Next, what fruit rises in me? Wisdom from above brings purity and peace, not pressure and panic. Finally, what do mature believers say, and what doors is God opening or closing? Sometimes the silence is an invitation to slow, not stop. If you get two yeses and a wait, keep praying and prepare. Three yeses, take the step. Save this and use it all week.

title: Stop Overthinking: The Simple 3‑Filter Guide
hook: You may be overthinking this. Try these three filters.
script: You may be overthinking this: God’s voice is simpler than you think. Run it through three filters. Bible: Is it consistent with God’s Word you already know? Spirit: Does it produce love, joy, and a settled peace, even if it’s hard? Community and circumstances: Do trusted believers confirm it, and are doors opening without manipulation? Score it. Three yeses, go. Two yeses, go slow and keep praying. One or zero, no—wait on God. His sheep know His voice, and He is not trying to trick you. Rewatch this next time your mind races, and let peace lead your steps.
